about: The ten Pit ranks' named opponents (name, source citation, backstory) per ranked roster character, rank 1 first. Cosmetic text only. Keyed by catalogue row id (src/fight/catalogue-data.ts); src/fight/catalogue-rows.ts joins them onto the rows as `ranks`. Moved byte-for-byte from the rows (test/legends-rows.test.mjs pins it).

veteran.name: Crixus
veteran.backstory: A Gaul sold to Capua's schools who broke out beside Spartacus and led his own army till Rome caught it. In Frankendom he fights with nothing to lose.

veteran.name: Ragnar Lothbrok
veteran.backstory: The raider who sailed up the Seine, took Paris and died singing in a pit of snakes. In Frankendom he fights laughing, as if the snakes were waiting.

veteran.name: Beowulf
veteran.backstory: The Geat who crossed the sea to tear Grendel's arm off bare-handed, then went into the mere after the mother. In Frankendom he fights trusting his grip.

veteran.name: Spartacus
veteran.backstory: The Thracian who broke out of Capua with seventy men and beat Rome's armies for two years. In Frankendom he fights as the man every slave watches.

veteran.name: Miyamoto Musashi
veteran.backstory: The ronin who won sixty duels, one with an oar he carved on the boat to the island. In Frankendom he fights arriving late and calm.

veteran.name: Hannibal
veteran.backstory: The Carthaginian who marched elephants over the Alps and destroyed eight legions at Cannae. In Frankendom he fights as a trap that closes unseen.

veteran.name: Leonidas
veteran.backstory: The Spartan king who held Thermopylae with a few hundred men till none were left. In Frankendom he fights as if the pass were at his back.

veteran.name: Ajax
veteran.backstory: The Greek with the tower shield who stood alone over the ships when the line broke, and fought Hector to a draw. In Frankendom he fights as a walking wall.

veteran.name: Alexander
veteran.backstory: The Macedonian who never lost a battle, and wept that of endless worlds he ruled not one. In Frankendom he fights at the head of the charge.

veteran.name: Mars
veteran.backstory: Father of Romulus and lord of the legions, whose name Rome gave to its field of war. In Frankendom he fights as war itself, owed a tithe of every duel.

pitborn.name: Pit Thrall
pitborn.backstory: A nameless brute bought for the pits and kept on scraps between bouts. In Frankendom he fights because he knows nothing else, and hits like a thrown stone.

pitborn.name: Cacus
pitborn.backstory: The fire-breathing giant who stole Heracles' cattle, dragging them into his cave by their tails so the tracks led away. In Frankendom he fights as a thief.

pitborn.name: Redcap
pitborn.backstory: The fiend of the old border tales who dyed his cap red in the blood of travellers caught in his ruin. In Frankendom he fights to keep his cap wet.

pitborn.name: Gogmagog
pitborn.backstory: The last giant of Albion, who wrestled the Trojan Corineus on a sea cliff and was thrown down. In Frankendom he fights to win the throw he lost.

pitborn.name: Grendel
pitborn.backstory: The fen-walker who raided a king's hall by night for twelve winters, hating its song. In Frankendom he fights as a creature of the marsh, furious and unrelenting.

pitborn.name: Polyphemus
pitborn.backstory: The one-eyed shepherd giant who penned Odysseus in his cave and lost his eye to a sharpened stake. In Frankendom he fights with a giant's anger.

pitborn.name: Humbaba
pitborn.backstory: Guardian of the Cedar Forest, whose roar was a flood and whose breath was death, set there by the gods. In Frankendom he fights as the forest's wrath.

pitborn.name: Antaeus
pitborn.backstory: The wrestler-giant who grew stronger each time he touched the earth, till Heracles held him aloft. In Frankendom he fights low, rising from every fall.

pitborn.name: Surtr
pitborn.backstory: The fire giant of Muspelheim, who waits at the edge of the world to set it alight at its end. In Frankendom he fights as the last blaze.

pitborn.name: Typhon
pitborn.backstory: The storm-serpent giant with a hundred heads, the deadliest foe Zeus ever faced. In Frankendom he fights as the monster the gods themselves fled.

goblin.name: Sewer Imp
goblin.backstory: A gutter-born scrap of malice that lives on what the drains carry. In Frankendom he fights dirty, fast and low, and runs before anyone can catch him.

goblin.name: Kobold
goblin.backstory: A house and mine spirit who helps when fed and plays cruel tricks when slighted. In Frankendom he fights as a grudge with a knife.

goblin.name: Nain Rouge
goblin.backstory: The red dwarf of the Detroit river, whose sighting warned of disaster and who cursed the man who struck him. In Frankendom he fights as ill luck.

goblin.name: Andvari
goblin.backstory: A dwarf who lived as a pike in a waterfall and cursed the ring Loki stole from him. In Frankendom he fights to make every taker regret it.

goblin.name: Alberich
goblin.backstory: The dwarf who guarded the Nibelung hoard and wore a cloak that made him unseen, till Siegfried took it. In Frankendom he fights as a keeper of stolen gold.

goblin.name: Rumpelstiltskin
goblin.backstory: The little man who spun straw into gold for a price and lost all when his name was spoken. In Frankendom he fights as a bargain that always comes due.

goblin.name: Puck
goblin.backstory: The hobgoblin who leads night travellers astray and laughs at their falls. In Frankendom he fights as a prank with sharp edges, never where you swing.

goblin.name: Reynard the Fox
goblin.backstory: The red fox of the beast fables, who talks his way out of every noose the king's court ties. In Frankendom he fights with a smile and a bite.

goblin.name: Hermes
goblin.backstory: Messenger of the gods, who stole Apollo's cattle on the day he was born and talked his way free. In Frankendom he fights with quick feet and a liar's smile.

goblin.name: Loki
goblin.backstory: The shape-changing trickster of Asgard, both help and ruin to the gods, bound at last until the world ends. In Frankendom he fights as mischief unchained.

nightborn.name: Night Page
nightborn.backstory: A pale servant of some darker house, sent out after dusk on errands no one names. In Frankendom he fights quietly, eager to earn his master's notice.

nightborn.name: Lord Ruthven
nightborn.backstory: A cold nobleman who moved through society charming the young and leaving them drained. In Frankendom he fights with courtly manners and patient thirst.

nightborn.name: Varney
nightborn.backstory: Sir Francis Varney, an undead gentleman who hated what he was and fed anyway. In Frankendom he fights long, grim bouts, as if he could not stop.

nightborn.name: Carmilla
nightborn.backstory: A countess dead for a century, who returned as a lonely girl to feed on the one she loved. In Frankendom she fights with sad eyes and no mercy at all.

nightborn.name: Erlking
nightborn.backstory: The king of the elves who rides the night woods and takes children from their fathers' arms. In Frankendom he fights as the cold wind in the trees.

nightborn.name: Mordred
nightborn.backstory: The traitor knight who seized Arthur's throne and met him in the last battle at Camlann. In Frankendom he fights as betrayal with a sword.

nightborn.name: Vlad
nightborn.backstory: Wallachia's prince who held the Danube from the Sultan and met him with a forest of stakes. In Frankendom he fights as the terror at the gate.

nightborn.name: Set
nightborn.backstory: Lord of desert and storm, who slew his brother Osiris and fought Horus for the throne. In Frankendom he fights as chaos in the red sand.

nightborn.name: Hades
nightborn.backstory: King of the dead, who rules beneath the earth and lets no soul go home. In Frankendom he fights as the host of the last feast.

nightborn.name: Nyx
nightborn.backstory: Night herself, older than the gods, whom even Zeus feared to anger. In Frankendom she fights as the dark that falls on every arena at last.

executioner.name: Headsman
executioner.backstory: A hooded servant of the block who does the work the law will not do with its own hands. In Frankendom he fights as a job to be finished cleanly.

executioner.name: Ankou
executioner.backstory: The last man to die each year, who drives a creaking cart to gather the souls of the next. In Frankendom he fights as the one you hear before you see.

executioner.name: Charon
executioner.backstory: The ferryman of the dead, who poles the river Styx and wants his coin before he takes you over. In Frankendom he fights as the price of crossing.

executioner.name: Hel
executioner.backstory: Loki's daughter, half living and half dead, who rules the dead who fall without glory. In Frankendom she fights as the cold hall no warrior wants.

executioner.name: Anubis
executioner.backstory: The jackal-headed guardian who weighs each heart against a feather. In Frankendom he fights as judgement, and he has already read the scales.

executioner.name: Ereshkigal
executioner.backstory: The queen of the land of no return, who stripped her own sister of every jewel at the seven gates. In Frankendom she fights as a gate that takes.

executioner.name: The Morrigan
executioner.backstory: The war goddess who washes the armour of doomed men at the ford and flies over battle as a crow. In Frankendom she fights as the omen that came true.

executioner.name: Arawn
executioner.backstory: The grey-clad king of Annwn, the otherworld, who hunts with white hounds and traded places with a mortal prince for a year. In Frankendom he fights as a hunt.

executioner.name: Thanatos
executioner.backstory: Death himself, twin of Sleep, with a heart of iron: he lets go of no one he takes, not even kings. In Frankendom he fights without hurry, as he always arrives.

executioner.name: The Reaper
executioner.backstory: The skeleton with the scythe who leads pope, king and beggar in the Dance of Death on old church walls. In Frankendom he fights as the harvest.

dwarf.name: Forge Hand
dwarf.backstory: A soot-black apprentice who carries coal and swings the striker's hammer for his master. In Frankendom he fights with the arms of a man who never rests.

dwarf.name: Alvis
dwarf.backstory: The all-wise dwarf who came for Thor's daughter and was kept answering Thor's questions till sunrise turned him to stone. In Frankendom he fights the dawn.

dwarf.name: Regin
dwarf.backstory: The smith who forged Sigurd's sword so the boy could slay his dragon brother. In Frankendom he fights as a craftsman with a grudge older than the blade.

dwarf.name: Brokkr
dwarf.backstory: The dwarf who bet Loki's head his brother could outdo the sons of Ivaldi, and won the gods Thor's hammer. In Frankendom he fights to collect the wager.

dwarf.name: Eitri
dwarf.backstory: The master smith who forged Mjolnir, a golden boar and a ring that drips eight more. In Frankendom he fights with a maker's eye for the weak seam.

dwarf.name: Wayland
dwarf.backstory: The smith lamed by a greedy king, who forged wings and took a terrible revenge. In Frankendom he fights as the craftsman no chain can hold.

dwarf.name: Kothar-wa-Khasis
dwarf.backstory: The skilled and wise god of craft who built Baal's palace and forged the clubs that beat the sea. In Frankendom he fights with tools made for gods.

dwarf.name: Ptah
dwarf.backstory: The creator god of Memphis, patron of builders, who shaped the world by thought and word. In Frankendom he fights as the first maker.

dwarf.name: Goibniu
dwarf.backstory: The smith of the Tuatha De Danann who forged spearheads in three blows for the war on the Fomorians. In Frankendom he fights as the forge at full heat.

dwarf.name: Hephaestus
dwarf.backstory: The lame smith of Olympus, cast out by his own mother, who forged the armour of heroes. In Frankendom he fights as the god who armed them all.

plaguedoctor.name: Beak
plaguedoctor.backstory: A masked town physician who walks the plague streets with herbs in his beak and a cane to keep the sick away. In Frankendom he fights at arm's length.

plaguedoctor.name: Paracelsus
plaguedoctor.backstory: The Swiss physician who burned the old medical books in Basel and healed with metals and poisons. In Frankendom he fights as a measure of harm.

plaguedoctor.name: Locusta
plaguedoctor.backstory: The poisoner of Nero's Rome, hired by an empress and an emperor to clear the way to the throne. In Frankendom she fights with a patient, quiet malice.

plaguedoctor.name: Medea
plaguedoctor.backstory: The Colchian sorceress who brewed potions for Jason and poisoned a princess with a gown. In Frankendom she fights as betrayal brewed in a pot.

plaguedoctor.name: Circe
plaguedoctor.backstory: The enchantress of Aeaea who turned Odysseus's crew into swine with a cup of wine. In Frankendom she fights to make a beast of her foe.

plaguedoctor.name: Sekhmet
plaguedoctor.backstory: The lioness goddess whose breath was the desert wind and who sent plague on the wicked. In Frankendom she fights as fever with teeth.

plaguedoctor.name: Nergal
plaguedoctor.backstory: The lord of the underworld who brought plague, war and scorching noon. In Frankendom he fights as the sickness that follows armies.

plaguedoctor.name: Apollo
plaguedoctor.backstory: The archer god whose arrows brought plague to the Greek camp at Troy for nine days. In Frankendom he fights as healing and sickness from one hand.

plaguedoctor.name: Hecate
plaguedoctor.backstory: The goddess of crossroads, herbs and witchcraft, who walks with torches and hounds. In Frankendom she fights as every poison's patron.

plaguedoctor.name: Resheph
plaguedoctor.backstory: The Canaanite lord of plague and war, whose arrows carried pestilence through the ranks of armies. In Frankendom he fights as sickness loosed from a bow.

knight.name: Squire
knight.backstory: A lord's boy who polishes the mail and holds the horse, hungry for his own spurs. In Frankendom he fights to prove he is ready for them.

knight.name: Bedivere
knight.backstory: The knight who stayed with Arthur to the end and returned the sword to the lake. In Frankendom he fights with a loyal heart.

knight.name: Gawain
knight.backstory: The courteous nephew of Arthur who grew stronger as the sun climbed toward noon. In Frankendom he fights best in the heat of the day.

knight.name: Roland
knight.backstory: The paladin who held the pass at Roncevaux and blew his horn only when all was lost. In Frankendom he fights too proud to call for help.

knight.name: El Cid
knight.backstory: The exiled Castilian lord who took Valencia against every king and, it is told, rode out after death. In Frankendom he fights for no king.

knight.name: Lancelot
knight.backstory: The greatest knight of the Round Table, undone by a love his king could not forgive. In Frankendom he fights flawless, and knows it.

knight.name: Siegfried
knight.backstory: The dragon-slayer who bathed in the beast's blood and was left with one small bare spot. In Frankendom he fights as though he cannot be hurt, almost.

knight.name: Hector
knight.backstory: The prince of Troy, its best defender, who faced Achilles alone outside the walls. In Frankendom he fights for everyone behind him.

knight.name: Achilles
knight.backstory: The greatest of the Greeks, who chose a short life of glory and was undone only at the heel. In Frankendom he fights as wrath made perfect.

knight.name: Thor
knight.backstory: The thunder god with the hammer Mjolnir, guardian of gods and men against the giants. In Frankendom he fights as the storm that hammers back.

witch.name: Hedge Witch
witch.backstory: A village wise woman who knows which root heals and which one kills. In Frankendom she fights with the same knowledge, and a sharp tongue.

witch.name: Mother Shipton
witch.backstory: The cave-born Yorkshire prophetess of the chapbooks, who foretold fires, wars and the fall of great men. In Frankendom she fights as one who saw the end.

witch.name: Grimhild
witch.backstory: The queen who brewed a drink of forgetting and turned heroes against their oaths. In Frankendom she fights to make you lose your place.

witch.name: Ceridwen
witch.backstory: The enchantress whose cauldron brewed a year for three drops of wisdom, then chased the thief through every shape. In Frankendom she fights as a pursuit.

witch.name: Nimue
witch.backstory: The Lady of the Lake who learned Merlin's secrets and sealed him away with them. In Frankendom she fights as the student who surpassed the master.

witch.name: Louhi
witch.backstory: The mistress of the cold North who stole the sun and moon and fought for the magic mill. In Frankendom she fights as winter with a grudge.

witch.name: Baba Yaga
witch.backstory: The witch of the deep forest who lives in a hut on hen's legs and flies in a mortar. In Frankendom she fights as the forest's oldest threat.

witch.name: Morgan le Fay
witch.backstory: The enchantress, half-sister to Arthur, who schemed against his court and carried him to Avalon. In Frankendom she fights as both foe and kin.

witch.name: Merlin
witch.backstory: The wizard born of a mortal and a spirit, who raised a king and foresaw his fall. In Frankendom he fights as foresight, a step ahead of every swing.

witch.name: Odin
witch.backstory: The All-Father who gave an eye for wisdom and hung nine nights on the world tree to win the runes. In Frankendom he fights as the price of knowing.

shieldmaiden.name: Shield Girl
shieldmaiden.backstory: A farmer's daughter who took up her dead brother's shield and never gave it back. In Frankendom she fights stubborn and square behind the boss.

shieldmaiden.name: Hervor
shieldmaiden.backstory: The shieldmaiden who woke her dead father in his barrow to claim the cursed sword Tyrfing. In Frankendom she fights with a blade the dead would not keep.

shieldmaiden.name: Camilla
shieldmaiden.backstory: The swift warrior queen of the Volsci, raised in the wild, who led cavalry against the Trojans. In Frankendom she fights at a run, too fast to pin.

shieldmaiden.name: Lagertha
shieldmaiden.backstory: A warrior woman who fought beside Ragnar and turned a lost battle with her charge. In Frankendom she fights where the line is breaking.

shieldmaiden.name: Boudica
shieldmaiden.backstory: The queen of the Iceni who rose against Rome and burned three of its cities. In Frankendom she fights for vengeance, and she does not bargain.

shieldmaiden.name: Tomyris
shieldmaiden.backstory: The Massagetae queen who defeated Cyrus the Great and, the story goes, plunged his head into a skin of blood. In Frankendom she fights as an empire's end.

shieldmaiden.name: Scathach
shieldmaiden.backstory: The warrior woman of the Isle of Skye who trained Cu Chulainn in every feat of arms. In Frankendom she fights as the teacher of champions.

shieldmaiden.name: Penthesilea
shieldmaiden.backstory: The Amazon queen who came to Troy's aid and fell to Achilles, who grieved to see her face. In Frankendom she fights as the equal of heroes.

shieldmaiden.name: Brynhildr
shieldmaiden.backstory: The valkyrie cast down for choosing her own victor, sleeping in a ring of fire until a hero rode through. In Frankendom she fights as the chooser of the slain.

shieldmaiden.name: Athena
shieldmaiden.backstory: Goddess of wisdom and war, born armoured from her father's head. In Frankendom she fights as strategy itself, and the aegis turns every blow.
